 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Dr. Anshuman
 Oral Judgment
 Date : 21-06-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, counsel  for the State and counsel for the N.H.A.I.

Counsel for petitioner submits that the present writ  petition has been filed for grant of compensation to the  petitioner for his 12 decimal of land appertaining to Khata No.
 835, Plot No. 98, Thana No. 118 of Jamabandi No.3555 situated  in Mohalla- Udamrekha, mauza- Sirsia near Fasia Tola, District-  Katihar.
 Counsel submits that petitioner purchased the  aforesaid land from Md. Amir and Md. Anwar, both are sons of Bibi Sanwar Khatoon Alias Sanwar ... vs The Union Of India on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161154609/

sentences.text: Counsel further submits  that for the purpose of construction of National Highway 131A  (Narayanpur- Purnia section), the said land was acquired.
Patna High Court CWJC No.439 of 2023 dt.21-06-2023  2/3
According to him, no compensation was paid till date.

Counsel  submits that upon his several representations filed, the Circle  Officer, Katihar has communicated a letter No. 1138 dated  08.04.2022 as Annexure-7 in which details of the jamabandi, raiyat and description of land like whose lands were taken for the purpose of construction of National Highway 131A, was given.
Counsel for petitioner further submits that due to mistake of ex-karamchari, the name of petitioner could not be given under Section 3(G) of National Highways Act, 1956.

Counsel further submits that in the Gazette notification, name of vendor of the petitioner is there but since the petitioner is the purchaser of the said land, therefore, petitioner's name could not be inserted and in result even award could not be prepared in her name.

Counsel submits that in the letter No. 3940 dated 02.12.2022 issued by Circle Officer, Katihar to the Land Acquisition Officer, Katihar which is annexed as Annexure-14 to the Supplementary affidavit, the name of petitioner has been figured.

Counsel for N.H.A.I. submits that all the amount for acquisition of land has already been deposited before the Land Acquisition Officer, if any amount not paid towards compensation due to any reason or the payment could not be received by the petitioner, the Land Acquisition Officer, Katihar is the competent person who shall prepare award and shall pay Patna High Court CWJC No.439 of 2023 dt.21-06-2023 compensation accordingly to petitioner.
Counsel for State seeks time to file counter- affidavit in this case.

It is a case of 2016 and such a long period has lapsed, therefore, this Court is of the view that the pendency of this case shall not solve any purpose and, therefore, it is directed to the Collector of Katihar that he shall supervise this matter at his level and shall assure the preparation of award and payment of compensation to the petitioner in accordance with law at the instance of Land Acquisition Officer who is competent authority under the statute.
